acceptanceCriteria: Actual pass/assertion-fail/XCTSkip fixture retains three distinct native outcomes via a qualified lossless transport.
Skipped-as-passed XML cannot satisfy complete CEM execution or criterion evidence; exact Swift version/platform limits are retained.
body: Observed actual Swift6.4 --parallel --xunit-output fixture: XCTSkip appears as ordinary passed testcase. Sequential invocation emits no XML. Corvint must retain unsupported native XML profile and add a lossless native XCTest transport before qualification. Actual source/raw witness under /private/tmp/cem10-build/native and platform Swift fixtures; experimental CEM runner profile currently rejects this source. This is a confirmed report-fidelity gap for the observed toolchain, not a claim every Swift version is broken.
title: SwiftPM 6.4 xUnit output loses XCTest skipped outcomes
